name: Aurora Alarm — flip a physical thing when something breaks
description: Demo 1. Fires the relay when any CRITICAL finding lands on the current bundle. The relay drives the smart plug / LED / servo + lights the OBS overlay card in sync.

metadata.note: Stream factory_bearing_demo.csv via demos/replay.py. The crit anomaly lands ~70% through the file. Overlay card fires in sync with the physical reaction.
